alt: Bottles of RE Liquia artisanal fruit liqueur on a wooden shelf at Bodegas RE, Casablanca Valley
caption: Bodegas RE make more than wine — their Liquia fruit liqueurs are bottled on site.

alt: Three visitors looking at shelves of glass demijohns beside oak barrels in a winery cellar
caption: The cellar at Bodegas RE, where wine ages in clay, glass and oak side by side.

alt: Concrete winery building and gravel courtyard under a broad shade tree, mountains behind
caption: The courtyard at Casas del Bosque, our second stop on the Classic Wine Tour.

alt: Bottle of Loma Larga Saga Cabernet Franc 2011 on a tasting table, Casablanca Valley
caption: Loma Larga's Saga Cabernet Franc — unusual for Casablanca, which is better known for whites.

alt: Close-up of a Quintay Brut Nature traditional-method sparkling wine label
caption: Quintay's Brut Nature, made by the traditional method — one of the stops on our sparkling wine tour.

alt: Long wooden trestle tables set for a group lunch in a winery dining hall
caption: Set up for a group lunch at Lapostolle, Colchagua Valley.

alt: Bottle of Montes Purple Angel Carmenère 2012 from the Colchagua Valley, Chile
caption: Purple Angel — Montes's flagship Carmenère, from a Colchagua custom tour.

alt: Horse-drawn carriage beside autumn vineyard rows with mountains in the distance
caption: Viu Manent still runs their vineyard tours by horse and carriage.

alt: Small group of guests walking a dirt track between dormant vine rows, hazy hills behind
caption: Winter in Colchagua — the vines are bare, and the valley is quiet.

alt: Couple toasting with glasses of sparkling wine at a winery restaurant table
caption: Lunch stop on the Wine & Dine Tour.

alt: Group of tour guests walking a palm-lined dirt drive towards a vineyard on a clear day
caption: Most of our groups are six to eight people — small enough to keep together.

alt: Couple toasting with sparkling wine in a winery shop lined with shelves of bottles
caption: The tasting room shop, where most guests end up buying a bottle to take home.

alt: Panna cotta with berry compote, sorbet and fresh berries on a white plate at a winery restaurant
caption: Dessert at the winery restaurant on the Wine & Dine Tour.

alt: Grilled octopus served on a warm vegetable salad at a winery restaurant
caption: Grilled octopus — Chile's coast turns up on the menu even inland.

alt: Vineyard rows leading to a modern white winery building with mountains behind, Casablanca Valley
caption: The Casablanca Valley sits between the coast and the coastal range, thirty kilometres from Valparaíso.

alt: View across a green valley from a flowering hillside at dusk
caption: Looking down over the valley floor from the hills above.

alt: Guest leaning over an oak barrel to smell wine through the bung hole in a barrel room
caption: Tasting straight from the barrel — most cellar tours include this if you ask.

alt: Bottles of Bodegas RE Noir chilling on ice in a white bathtub, decorated with flowers
caption: RE Noir on ice at Bodegas RE.

alt: Guide and two guests taking a selfie in front of a white tower building on a clear day
caption: On the city tour, somewhere along the coast.

alt: Dirt drive lined with tall palms and rose bushes leading into a vineyard
caption: Palms and roses along the drive — roses at the end of vine rows are an old trick for spotting mildew early.

alt: Three guests standing in front of the Emiliana Organic Vineyards sign in the Casablanca Valley
caption: Emiliana is the valley's best-known organic and biodynamic producer.

alt: Couple standing beside the tour van at a vineyard, palms and vine rows behind
caption: Our van, and where it takes you. Hotel pickup is included on every tour.

alt: Older couple seated at a tasting table in a winery shop lined with bottles and glassware
caption: Between courses at a winery lunch.

alt: Couple toasting with white wine at a set table on a shaded winery terrace
caption: Lunch on the terrace, looking out over the vines.

alt: Couple at a restaurant table on a terrace overlooking olive groves and hills
caption: A hilltop restaurant with the valley below — a stop on the Wine & Dine Tour.

alt: Couple seated at a laid table in a winery dining room, awards framed on the wall behind
caption: Waiting for the first course at a winery lunch.

alt: Four guests with wine glasses at an open-air stone tasting bar looking out over vineyards
caption: An outdoor tasting bar built into the hillside, with the valley in front of you.

alt: Two guests holding glasses of red wine at a tasting room table
caption: Working through a red flight.

alt: Couple sitting and talking on a sunny winery terrace with vines behind
caption: Nobody hurries you between tastings.

alt: Couple nosing glasses of red wine at a tasting room table set with several glasses
caption: Learning to nose a wine before tasting it — part of every cellar visit.

alt: Couple laughing over a shared dessert platter at a winery restaurant
caption: The dessert platter tends to end the Wine & Dine Tour.

alt: Couple seated with two bottles of white wine in the Bodegas RE tasting room, shelves of wine behind
caption: Tasting at Bodegas RE, whose blends carry names like Syranoir and Chardonnoir.

alt: Couple toasting with sparkling wine at a winery bar lined with shelves of bottles
caption: A glass of sparkling to start.

alt: Couple raising sparkling wine flutes in a winery tasting room
caption: Toasting in the tasting room.

alt: Couple seated at a round table with a flight of wine glasses in the Bodegas RE tasting room
caption: A full flight at Bodegas RE — the tasting takes as long as you want it to.

alt: Group of guests tasting wine at a plank table set on barrels in a winery courtyard, with a host pouring
caption: A standing tasting in the courtyard, poured straight from the barrel room.

alt: Guests walking between bare winter vines in morning mist, hills behind
caption: Winter in the vineyard — bare vines, mist, and nobody else there.

alt: Group of guests posing playfully on a winery path with mountains behind
caption: Small groups, and they usually end up like this by the second winery.

alt: Four guests standing beside an antique wooden wine press in a winery garden
caption: An old basket press kept in the garden — most estates still have one somewhere.

alt: Four guests raising glasses of white wine in a modern winery tasting room with a cheese board
caption: Casablanca is white wine country — Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay lead.

alt: Four guests seated around a tasting table with a cheese board in the Bodegas RE tasting room
caption: A cheese board alongside the flight at Bodegas RE.

alt: Four guests at a tasting table beside a clay amphora in the Bodegas RE tasting room
caption: Bodegas RE age some of their wine in clay — the amphora on the table is the real thing.

alt: Group of four at the end of lunch in a winery restaurant, dessert plates cleared
caption: The end of a long lunch on the Wine & Dine Tour.

alt: Rows of oak barrels under brick arches in the Loma Larga barrel cellar, two visitors walking between them
caption: The barrel cellar at Loma Larga, dug into the hillside to hold its own temperature.

alt: Low morning fog filling a valley between wooded hills at first light
caption: The camanchaca — coastal fog that rolls in off the Pacific and keeps this valley cool enough for Sauvignon Blanc.

alt: Prawns cooked in garlic and olive oil, served sizzling in a cast-iron pan
caption: Camarones al pil pil — a Chilean coastal classic, and a good reason to take the lunch option.

alt: Modern winery tasting room with a low sofa, candlesticks and a wooden bar lined with bottles
caption: The tasting room at Quintay.

alt: Winemaker explaining barrel ageing to two guests in front of stacked oak barrels
caption: Most estates will let the winemaker talk you through the barrel hall if you ask in advance.

alt: Winemaker drawing wine from the valve of a stainless steel fermentation tank
caption: Straight from the tank — wine that hasn't been bottled and never will be sold by the glass.

alt: Circular cellar with conical vats arranged in a ring beneath tall backlit windows
caption: Lapostolle's circular gravity-flow cellar in Colchagua, built so the wine never needs pumping.

alt: Bottles of Bodegas RE olive oil and wine balsamic vinegar lined up on a shelf
caption: Bodegas RE also press olive oil and make a balsamic from Cabernet Sauvignon.

alt: Artisan shop interior with handwoven ponchos, straw hats and strings of dried chillies
caption: Handwoven wool and strings of dried ají — worth a stop if you want something to take home.

alt: Antique wooden harvest trays painted orange, resting on an old ox cart beside lavender
caption: Harvest trays on an old ox cart. Grapes were carried like this within living memory.

alt: Wide view across a green valley of vineyards and fields from a hillside, with the highway running through it
caption: The valley from above, with Route 68 running through the middle — the road between Santiago and Valparaíso.

alt: Bottles of Loma Larga unfiltered Malbec 2009 and Syrah 2008 from the Casablanca Valley
caption: Loma Larga bottle their reds unfiltered — unusual in a valley known for whites.

alt: Rows of stainless steel fermentation tanks with walkways beneath a curved wooden ceiling
caption: The fermentation hall. Every cellar tour starts somewhere like this.

alt: Cheese cubes and crackers served on a wooden board beside a wine bottle and glasses
caption: A cheese plate comes with most tastings — it's not just the wine.

alt: Line of white wine glasses along a tasting bar with a host beside them
caption: A flight lined up along the bar, poured lightest to heaviest.

alt: Branded Catrala wooden case holding six bottles of Casablanca Valley wine
caption: A six-bottle case from Catrala, one of the valley's small boutique producers.

alt: Winery worker in a Catrala fleece applying labels to bottles by hand
caption: At Catrala the bottles are still labelled by hand, one at a time.

alt: Close view of hands smoothing a label onto a wine bottle at a labelling bench
caption: Small production means no labelling line — just a bench, a stack of labels and a steady hand.

alt: Guide explaining barrel ageing beside stacked oak barrels branded Catrala
caption: The barrel hall at Catrala. The estate's name is burned into the barrel heads.

alt: Bottles of Catrala Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir Grand Reserve on a tasting bar
caption: Catrala's Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir — the two grapes Casablanca does best.

alt: Close-up of a Catrala Pinot Noir Grand Reserve 2009 label from the Casablanca Valley
caption: A 2009 Pinot Noir Grand Reserve — older vintages are often still pourable at the estate itself.

alt: Couple sitting with glasses of white wine on a red leather sofa in a winery lounge
caption: Not every tasting happens at a bar.

alt: Guide talking to a family group on a walkway above stainless steel fermentation tanks
caption: The walkway above the tanks — where the guide explains what happens between grape and bottle.

alt: Cellar worker moving a gas cylinder between oak barrels and steel tanks
caption: Inert gas keeps oxygen off the wine when a tank or barrel is opened. Small details like this are what a cellar visit shows you.

alt: Cellar worker in an orange cap topping up an oak barrel
caption: Topping up. Wine evaporates through the oak, and the gap has to be filled or the wine oxidises.

alt: Cellar worker drawing wine out of an oak barrel through a hose
caption: Racking — moving wine off its sediment into a clean barrel.

alt: Group of guests standing among oak barrels during a cellar tour, barrel bungs in the foreground
caption: A cellar tour in progress.

alt: Family group standing between fermentation tanks and oak barrels in a winery cellar
caption: Groups stay small enough that everyone can hear the guide.

alt: Guide explaining trellised vines on a hillside to three guests, roses planted along the rows
caption: Out in the vineyard before the cellar. The roses along the rows aren't decoration — they're a warning system.

alt: Family group listening to a guide among stainless steel tanks, oak barrels and plastic fermenters
caption: A small working cellar: steel, oak and plastic all in one room, because nothing here is done at scale.

alt: Red desk bell reading "Ring for Wine" on a polished wooden tasting table
caption: Ring for wine.

alt: Fresh congrio laid out on a blue tarpaulin at a Chilean fish market beside a pile of crab claws
caption: Congrio and crab claws on the tarpaulin. Neruda wrote an ode to congrio soup, and it's still on every menu on this coast.

alt: Visitors reading a large Quintay Wine Estate map board explaining the Casablanca Valley's maritime influence
caption: The board at Quintay maps how far the sea reaches inland — 15 km of direct marine influence, then 25, then 35. That gradient is the whole valley in one picture.

alt: Rows of French oak barrels stencilled Viña Quintay, stacked on steel racks in a barrel hall
caption: Barrels at Quintay, stencilled with the estate name and the vintage, chalked with the block the fruit came from.

alt: Driver in sunglasses at the wheel of the tour van on the road to the Casablanca Valley
caption: The drive out. Route 68 from Valparaíso takes about forty minutes.

alt: Helicopter standing on dry ground beside vineyard rows under a clear sky
caption: Not on the standard tours — but a helicopter into the valley is one of the things a custom itinerary can include.

alt: Winery guide with a lanyard talking to two guests in front of a numbered stainless steel fermentation tank
caption: Tank 63. The guide will tell you what's in it and when it goes to barrel.

alt: Cellar worker tipping a wooden bucket of pale must into a lined bin beside a fermentation vat
caption: Harvest is the one time of year the cellar is genuinely busy, and the only time you see this.

alt: Filled wine bottles moving along a curved conveyor on a winery bottling line, worker alongside
caption: The bottling line. It runs a few weeks a year and stands still the rest.

alt: Hand pouring white wine into a line of tasting glasses, host smiling behind
caption: Pouring the first white of the flight.

alt: Large mural of a figure with outstretched hands and hummingbirds, painted across a house front on Cerro Alegre, Valparaíso
caption: A mural on Cerro Alegre, signed and dated 2011. Valparaíso repaints itself constantly — this is why the city tour is never quite the same twice.

alt: Rows of tasting glasses etched Casas del Bosque set out on a long table, two guests seated behind
caption: Glasses set out at Casas del Bosque before a tasting.

alt: Three guests seated at a tasting table with wine and a cheese board in the Bodegas RE shop, shelves of RE bottles behind
caption: Tasting at Bodegas RE, with the shelves of Renace and Chardonnoir behind.

alt: Four guests around a wooden table with a clay jar and a slate of cheese in the Bodegas RE shop
caption: The clay jar on the table isn't decoration — Bodegas RE age wine in vessels like it.

alt: Guide talking beside large oval oak casks in a vaulted brick underground cellar, small barrels racked opposite
caption: An underground cellar, brick-vaulted and dug in. Big casks on one side, small barrels on the other — they do different jobs.

alt: Winery host standing beside two large dark oak casks, one lit through the bung hole
caption: Old casks still in use. The bigger the barrel, the less oak flavour it gives.

alt: Four guests seated on low sofas around a table of wine glasses in a modern winery lounge open to a terrace
caption: A tasting on the sofas rather than at a bar — the room is open to the terrace on three sides.

alt: Three guests with wine glasses looking out over bare winter vines towards a lagoon and palm trees
caption: Winter, glass in hand, out in the rows. The vines are bare and there is nobody else there.

alt: Guest tasting white wine standing on a dirt track between bare winter vines, hills behind
caption: Tasting where the wine was grown, which is not the same as tasting indoors.

alt: Weathered wooden vineyard end post wrapped in trellis wire, hand-painted with a red number
caption: Every row is numbered by hand. This is how a picking crew knows where to start.

alt: Two visitors looking at a wall of framed black-and-white family photographs in a pale wood winery stairwell
caption: The family photographs on the stair wall. Several estates here were farms long before they were vineyards.

alt: Host pouring white wine at a tasting bar, framed 2008 wine awards on the shelves behind
caption: Pouring at the bar, under the awards.

alt: Group raising glasses along a long table in a warmly lit winery dining room, a Spanish inscription painted on the far wall
caption: A long table, a full set of glasses each, and an evening that runs past the itinerary.

alt: Row of Montes bottles — Limited Selection, Classic Series, Alpha and a traditional-method sparkling — set out for a tasting
caption: A Montes line-up, from the Classic Series up to Alpha. Colchagua, not Casablanca.

alt: Group of guests standing in a barrel cellar beside two large white concrete fermentation eggs
caption: Concrete eggs. No oak flavour, no steel, and the shape keeps the wine moving on its own.

alt: Close-up of an Emiliana La Cantera organic Garnacha, Syrah and Mourvèdre label from the Colchagua Valley
caption: Emiliana's La Cantera — Garnacha, Syrah and Mourvèdre, certified organic, from Colchagua.

alt: Straight dirt avenue running away between symmetrical blocks of vines towards distant hills
caption: The avenue runs dead straight from the winery door to the far end of the estate.

alt: Vineyard and mountains seen through a tall white arch of a winery building under a cloudy blue sky
caption: Framed by the arch of the winery gallery.

alt: Four guests seated at a balustrade on a chequerboard-tiled winery terrace, looking out over vine rows
caption: A tasting on the upper terrace, with the estate laid out in front of you.

alt: Glass of sparkling wine standing on a white terrace rail above vineyards and mountains
caption: One glass, one balustrade, the whole valley.

alt: Old circular stone grinding wheel with a worn central hole, resting flat on a wooden floor
caption: An old millstone kept at the estate.

alt: Stack of new French oak barrels branded Lapostolle, dated 2011, in a dim cellar
caption: Lapostolle's 2011 barrels, stacked and waiting.

alt: Close-up of a Lapostolle barrel head branded "France — grain fin", medium toast, 2010
caption: The barrel head says where the oak came from, how fine the grain is, how hard it was toasted and what year it was made. All of that changes the wine.

alt: Looking straight up through concentric circular openings to a bright round skylight above a cellar
caption: Looking straight up through the cellar.

alt: Grilled lamb chops served on a white plate with basil and parsley at a winery restaurant
caption: Lamb chops at the winery restaurant.

alt: Tall stacks of grey plastic harvest bins under a metal winery roof, one marked VTN 132
caption: Harvest bins stacked to the roof, numbered by block, waiting for picking to start.

alt: Winery workers in hairnets and aprons packing bottles into boxes along a bench
caption: Packing by hand at the end of the line.

alt: Three guests at a curved pale glass tasting bar with a host, glasses of red and white in front of them
caption: Working through reds and whites side by side at the bar.

alt: Huge old wooden wine cask marked 1,900 litres, standing outdoors with vine leaves growing up around it
caption: A 1,900-litre cask, retired outdoors and slowly being taken back by the vines.

alt: Three large old numbered wine casks standing beside vine rows with dry hills behind
caption: Casks 69 and 50, out of service and left where they stand. Wine was made in these before stainless steel arrived.
